description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named TitleBar for a Windows app, managing title bar appearance, behavior, and theme responsiveness.

classes.name: TitleBar
classes.description: A custom user control for managing the Windows title bar appearance and behavior, including theme and accessibility adjustments.

methods.name: TitleBar
methods.description: Constructor initializing title bar settings, event handlers, and theme adjustments.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for control load; registers event handlers and sets initial properties.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler for control unload; unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: RootFrame_RequestedThemeChanged
methods.description: Callback for theme change; updates title bar colors.

methods.name: CoreTitleBarIsVisibleChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes of the core title bar.

methods.name: CoreTitleBarLayoutMetricsChanged
methods.description: Handles layout metric changes of the core title bar.

methods.name: SetTitleBarVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the custom title bar based on conditions.

methods.name: SetTitleBarHeightAndPadding
methods.description: Adjusts height and padding of the title bar based on system metrics.

methods.name: ColorValuesChanged
methods.description: Handles color value changes to update title bar colors.

methods.name: SetTitleBarControlColors
methods.description: Applies color settings to the title bar buttons, considering high contrast mode.

methods.name: OnHighContrastChanged
methods.description: Handles high contrast accessibility setting changes.

methods.name: OnWindowActivated
methods.description: Updates visual state based on window activation.

methods.name: OnIsAlwaysOnTopModePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state when the AlwaysOnTop mode property changes.

methods.name: AlwaysOnTopButton_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the AlwaysOnTop button click, raising the AlwaysOnTopClick event.
